prompt: Use the provided reference image as the strict identity reference. Create a single 12-image collage featuring the exact same girl in every image. Her facial identity must remain perfectly consistent across all 12 variations. Do not create a different person or reinterpret her appearance. Arrange the result as a clean 4×3 professional studio portrait collage, with one hairstyle per panel. Keep the same framing, camera angle, pose, expression, clothing, makeup, accessories, background, and lighting in every panel. The only difference between the 12 images should be the hairstyle. Hairstyle variations 1. High ponytail — Sleek high ponytail with a smooth crown and long flowing length. 2. French bob — Jaw-length bob with a soft blunt micro-fringe across the forehead. 3. Long straight middle-part hair — Very long, sleek, pin-straight brown hair falling well below the shoulders, parted in the middle. 4. Shaggy wolf cut — Medium-length heavy layers, choppy fringe, textured volume, and a slightly wild finish. 5. Elegant updo — Polished high chignon with soft face-framing tendrils. 6. Short curly crop — Short, voluminous natural curls with tapered sides and a textured top. 7. Side-swept Hollywood waves — Long glamorous hair with a deep side part and sculpted vintage waves cascading over one shoulder. 8. Sleek low bun — Smooth center-parted hair gathered into a clean, polished low bun at the nape. 9. Long layered waves — Long brown hair with soft cascading layers and natural, loose waves. 10. Shoulder-length blunt cut — Straight, sleek shoulder-length hair with clean blunt ends and a middle part. 11. Curtain bangs — Long natural brown hair with soft curtain bangs framing the face and subtle movement through the lengths. 12. Textured pixie cut — Short modern pixie with textured volume on top, softly tapered sides, and a natural finish. Identity and consistency rules Hair color: Keep exactly the same natural brown hair color as the reference image. Only change: hair length, hair shape, hair texture, and hair styling. Never change: facial structure, face, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, age, makeup, clothing, accessories, pose, expression, or overall identity. The girl must look unmistakably like the same person in all 12 panels. Maintain identical facial proportions and recognizable features throughout the entire collage. Photography and rendering Professional studio portrait photography, Canon EOS R5, 85mm f/1.4 lens, soft key light with subtle fill, sharp focus on the face, natural shallow depth of field, realistic skin pores, individual hair strands, realistic hair texture. Photorealistic, hyperrealistic, extremely high detail, 8K quality, natural skin texture, realistic lighting, no CGI appearance, no plastic skin, no painterly effect. Create a clean, evenly spaced 4×3 collage, with each hairstyle clearly visible and distinctly different while maintaining perfect character consistency

promptZh: 请使用提供的参考图像作为严格的身份参考。创建一个包含 12 张图像的拼图，每张图像中必须是完全相同的 女孩。她的面部特征必须在所有 12 种变化中保持完美一致。请勿创建不同的人或重新诠释她的外貌。将结果排列为整洁的 4×3 专业影棚人像拼图，每个面板展示一种发型。在每个面板中保持相同的构图、拍摄角度、姿势、表情、服装、妆容、配饰、背景和光影。这 12 张图像之间唯一的区别应该是发型。发型变化：1. 高马尾 — 光滑的高马尾，头顶平整，长发垂顺。2. 法式波波头 — 下颌长度的波波头，前额带有柔和的平剪短刘海。3. 长直发中分 — 非常长、顺滑、笔直的棕色长发，垂至肩部以下，中分。4. 狼尾剪 — 中等长度的厚重层次，碎刘海，纹理感强，带有略显狂野的质感。5. 优雅盘发 — 精致的高发髻，带有柔和的修饰脸型的发丝。6. 短卷发 — 短而蓬松的自然卷发，两侧修剪利落，顶部富有纹理。7. 侧分好莱坞波浪卷 — 长发，深侧分，带有雕塑感的复古波浪垂在肩头。8. 光滑低发髻 — 中分发型，在颈后梳成整洁、精致的低发髻。9. 长层次波浪卷 — 棕色长发，带有柔和的层叠波浪和自然的松散卷度。10. 肩部长度平剪 — 直顺的肩部长度发型，发尾平整，中分。11. 八字刘海 — 长款自然棕色头发，带有柔和的八字刘海修饰脸型，发丝带有微妙的动感。12. 纹理感精灵短发 — 现代短款精灵头，顶部富有纹理，两侧自然修剪，效果自然。身份与一致性规则：发色：保持与参考图像完全相同的 自然棕色 发色。仅更改：头发长度、发型形状、头发纹理和发型样式。严禁更改：面部结构、脸型、眼睛、眉毛、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、肤色、年龄、妆容、服装、配饰、姿势、表情或整体身份。该女孩在所有 12 个面板中必须看起来是同一个人。在整个拼图中保持相同的面部比例和可辨认的特征。摄影与渲染：专业影棚人像摄影，Canon EOS R5，85mm f/1.4 镜头，柔和主光配合微妙补光，面部焦点清晰，自然的浅景深，真实的皮肤毛孔，清晰的发丝，真实的头发纹理。照片级真实感，超写实，极高细节，8K 画质，自然皮肤纹理，真实光影，无 CGI 感，无塑料感皮肤，无绘画效果。创建一个整洁、间距均匀的 4×3 拼图，确保每种发型清晰可见且各不相同，同时保持完美的人物一致性。
